comment: prove2.me upload plan (upload_full_project.md, Phase 2). `targets` are the project's main theorems (those in scripts/AxiomCheck.lean); generate.py adds every reachable theorem whose proof is > 40 lines, or 11-40 lines with a promotion signal (used by >= 2 nodes, used across files, has a docstring, or named in the papers), as a further node; every other reachable theorem is inlined into the solutions that use it. Definitions go to one Def bundle per source module, named bundlePrefix + module.
